summary: Drive Car in drive simulator! Driving, bus simulator & parking games for fun!
description:
Car Driving School Simulator is your ultimate way to drive car, practice and master various aspects, including extreme car driving and becoming a skilled car driver!

Whether you’re a fan of car  drive simulator games, love tackling car parking games, or are looking for a realistic bus simulator experience, or even willing to feel yourself a school bus driver -  this game has something for every car driver. Dive into the world of car simulator and take on exciting challenges. Test yourself against real-world rules like road signs, speed limits, and lane discipline in a safe and engaging driving game environment. 
 
When you're preparing for a license exam, sharpening your skills after getting your license, or just having fun, this drive simulator is your chance to test yourself. The game measures your car driver quality—covering basics like startup sequences, traffic navigation (including cars and pedestrians), lights, road signs, speed limits, and lane discipline. Plus, experience a full-featured bus simulator mode, giving you the chance to master bus driving and parking simulator skills as well.   

GAME FEATURES:  
▶ HUGE CAR COLLECTION: Feel free exploring over 39 awesome vehicles, including sedans, pickup trucks, muscle cars, 4x4s and buses. There is a plenty new vehicles to discover for any car games lover.  
▶ MULTIPLE VARIED MAPS: Drive car through 9 completely different locales, from California to Tokyo, Miami, and Norway, and immerse yourself in realistic driving games like never before.  
▶ REALISTIC TRAFFIC: Deal with Real Traffic AI. Perfect for honing your skills in car driving simulators and preparing for challenges like manual car driving or extreme car driving. 
 ▶ DYNAMIC WEATHER: Experience realistic road conditions with changing weather. Adapt your style to rain, snow, and sunny days for a full real driving simulator experience.  
▶ ONLINE MULTIPLAYER: Drive car and compete with people online for fun driving. 

. ▶ SEASONAL EVENTS: Participate in exciting surprises throughout the year and discover why this is one of the best car games on the market. 

Practice and Enjoy Realistic Car Exploring! Explore beautifully detailed maps and test what you’ve learned about driving car and parking. Whether you’re a fan of car parking simulators or want to experience a bus driver simulator, you’ll find plenty to keep you engaged. Drive around California, Canada, Aspen, Las Vegas, New York, Miami, Tokyo, and Norway. Each map brings new challenges for every driver game enthusiast. Complete dozens of missions that are extremely fun! 

REALISTIC TRAFFIC SIMULATION Take on the challenge of operating in real-world conditions with cars, pedestrians, and other obstacles. Perfect your manual car driving skills while keeping up with road rules. If you’re looking for realistic driving games that teach and entertain, this is the perfect choice for you. 

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER MODE Once you’ve mastered the single-player missions, switch to multiplayer mode for a change of pace. Compete in fun driving games, earn points for obeying traffic rules, and collect bonuses. Whether you’re into car simulator games or want to test yourself against others, the multiplayer mode has it all. 

FREE TO PLAY The Main Game Mode is 100% FREE to play, all the way through, no strings attached! Extra Game Modes which alter the rules slightly to make the game easier are available through optional In-App Purchases. Try out different car driving and car parking activities to challenge yourself with a variety of modes designed for every car parking school graduate. 

Car Driving School Simulator has been delighting fans of car simulator games, car parking games, and bus simulators since 2017. Constantly updated with new features, vehicles, and challenges, this game is the perfect car parking simulator for anyone looking to learn, practice, and have fun. Dive into the ultimate real driving simulator experience and join millions of players worldwide!
